text: Accepted architecture boundary: keep each effect_relation homogeneous and pair left/right relations during task compilation; do not turn relation into a heterogeneous bag. Preserve complete effect forms versus query-only effect_view as distinct result capabilities; query_only is not a storage codec. The implementation must be a conservative generalization: existing geometry(), cross_partitions(), bilinear_query(), packed storage, and eligible views remain compatibility specializations until differential certification permits old-kernel removal.
